title: setDepletionDuration has no minimum-duration floor and no two-step gate; one-tx flash drain of rewardBalance
description: setDepletionDuration is onlyOwner, has only require(_duration > 0), and applies immediately in the same transaction. There is no minimum-duration floor and no two-step preview/commit gate (asymmetric with setDesiredAPY which has at least a 100-block gate). An adversarial or compromised owner can collapse the depletion window to 1 second, causing the next _updatePool to credit the entire rewardBalance to accStablePerShare in one block.
impact: Owner can collapse the depletion window to 1 second; the next _updatePool credits the entire rewardBalance to accStablePerShare in a single block. Bundleable with a flash-stake to capture the full reward pool. This is the strongest concentration finding in the bundle because there is no friction at all — strictly worse than the uncapped APY surface (C-03) which at least has the two-step gate.
attackPath: Adversarial owner observes a substantial rewardBalance.
In one MEV bundle: setDepletionDuration(1) -> stake(huge_amount) -> _updatePool absorbs entire rewardBalance into accStablePerShare -> claim() pulls the full pool -> withdraw stake.
All rewardToken funding by external funders is captured by the owner-aligned staker.
likelihood: depends on owner trust; the function is onlyOwner
externalRequirements: Owner key control; non-zero rewardBalance at the moment of attack
recommendation: Add (a) a hard floor: require(_duration >= MIN_DEPLETION_DURATION) where MIN_DEPLETION_DURATION matches the intended distribution cadence (e.g., 1 day or 1 week minimum), and (b) a two-step preview/commit gate symmetric with setDesiredAPY (preview emits IntendedSetDuration; commit applies after a delay window). Optionally route through a timelock controller.
classifierRationale: onlyOwner with no gate; strictly worse than DEDUP-006. Still admin-only — C bundle with strongest commentary.
